entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 128855517166594048: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 13061: distance 52.604 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.011), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 52.604 +/- 0.579 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 19.0390 +/- 0.1262 mas (same row, RUWE 1.25), 150.9 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 150.336, -124.838 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 10.224 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 13061: radius 10.224 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 46.769 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.054) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4724 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 13061: effective temperature 4724 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.08).

entries.subject: Color
